summary: Re-tested the public mobile preview and backend regression suite. Customer registration/auth gate, five tabs, empty catalog, Home Shop now/View all routing, search/sort controls, empty cart, admin login, Admin Studio tabs, COD presentation, and protected orders behavior were exercised. Backend regression passed 3/3.
action_items: Add testID attributes to Admin Studio upload, category name/add, and product submit controls for deterministic mobile regression automation.
Consider removing or correcting the unused current_user Query-based authentication helper; active protected routes correctly use the Authorization header helper.
Use a required environment-provided JWT secret rather than the hardcoded fallback in backend/server.py for production configuration hardening.
critical_code_review_comments: The live frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from .env; the regression test file expects EXPO_BACKEND_URL, so the test command requires explicit environment mapping even though the app itself works.
The Cart screen intentionally hides storefront tabs and only exposes a back arrow; automation must navigate back before selecting Profile or another tab.
Admin Studio Products upload and form controls are interactive but lack stable testIDs, unlike the tab controls.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of executed core flows; admin upload text check was not independently asserted due to test script state sequencing

seed_data_creation: Created one uniquely prefixed customer through the existing backend regression test; no catalog or order seed data created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Initial catalog remains intentionally empty, so product-dependent cart/checkout submission and dispatched/cancelled deletion could not be exercised end-to-end. Admin login and protected orders API passed. Expo logs contain only the known root Electron DevTools sandbox warning; Metro bundles successfully.
rca_of_issue: No functional regression reproduced. The only automation interruptions were harness sequencing: Cart has no bottom tabs by design, and the admin upload assertion was made while the Orders tab was still selected.
